question: Who won the 'ICC Male Cricketer of the Decade' award in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __Virat Kohli.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In December 2020, the ICC introduced the "ICC Men's Cricketer of the Decade" award.
 
• The award aimed to honor the standout performer in international cricket from 2011 to 2020.
 
• It recognized the remarkable achievements and contributions of a cricketer over the decade.
 
• Indian cricket icon Virat Kohli was the recipient of this inaugural award.
 
• Kohli's exceptional batting records across all formats were highlighted.
 
• His leadership as captain of the Indian cricket team was also acknowledged.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Virat Kohli was born on November 5, 1988, in Delhi, India.
 
• He made his international cricket debut in 2008.
 
• He was appointed captain of the Indian cricket team in 2013.
 
• Kohli has led the team to significant victories, including historic Test series wins abroad.
 
• Kohli is an advocate for fitness and healthy living, promoting these values beyond the cricket field.
